one_liner: Plaid is a broad REST financial data API with a free Sandbox, a free Trial plan for new US/CA teams, and pay-as-you-go production access after approval.
auth_notes: The fetched pages don't show how the core API authenticates. The client_id and secret from the Dashboard, plus per-Item access_tokens from Link, come from background knowledge and the Composio catalog, which lists API_KEY for the plaid toolkit. The pages do mention access tokens (billing page). OAUTH2 is listed because Plaid's Dashboard MCP server reportedly uses OAuth client_credentials. The fetched pages don't confirm that either, and the Composio catalog shows DCR_OAUTH for plaid_mcp.
access_notes: Sandbox is always free. New US/CA teams created on or after 2026-04-15 can get a free Trial plan with real production data and up to 10 Production Items, auto-approved for most developers. Full Production needs approval (a few business days, with company and use-case info) and is paid. EU/UK customers can only get Custom plans.
blocker_notes: Sandbox and the Trial plan are self-serve. The Trial plan is limited to 10 Production Items and to US/CA developers. Scaling beyond that needs Production approval, which asks for company and use-case information. Each end user must also complete Plaid Link.
